tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rme brtsegs ljang dud la bsten pa'i grib glud rdzong chog 'gal rkyen mun sel khro bo'i gzi 'od bzhugs so// swasti/ rme brtsegs ljang nag jo lugs dang dud kha sa lugs khog gcig pas dud khar bkru byab bsrung gsum la grol grib glud gtong tshul mkhyen rab chos rje'i nag dpon bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad par lung dang phyag len bzhugs pas de'i rme brtsegs jo lugs la sbyar te bkru byab bsrung ba dum 'grel bar gnas skabs gzhan du gtong tshul ni bum chog gi chas rnams paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi mdzad pa'i yig cha bzhin la/ grib glud kyi chas 'bru sna tshogs tshad tshig phye nag por song ba'i tsam la grib gtor nag po gru gsum rtse dang ldebs la sgor rgyan sgrub bya'i dri chu las brdzis pa'i glud dril/ zan grib bdag mtshon byed mi'i gos thod nag po gyon zhing lag gnyis dar nag 'dzin pa rta nag sga srab sogs chas 'grig la bzhon pa'i rgyab tu 'jag ma sogs la bsten pa'i bya nag klad du lding mthar khyi nag rjes su 'breng ba/ gzhan yang mi 'du/ bya/ sbrul/ phag sbal pa'i mgo can/ lag cha med pa bzos la/ snod gcig gi nang du gtor ma de'i rgyab tu grib bdag dpon g.yog mdun du glud dang 'chang bu/ mtha' skor du khor yug dme po sogs kyi nang nas byung ba'i zas sogs dngos po sna tshogs bya ded spyang ded kyi sha sogs grib che rigs gang 'byor bzhag chab kyis bran/ nyams len gyi rim par/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bum nang gi lha zhu/ zin pa'i bar gong paṇa chen gyis yig cha bzhin byas la/ glud gtor sngags drug phyag drug gis byin rlabs pa ni lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā wā shud+dhasarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bhi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/

lan gsum gyis spel/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa'i gung mo sgreng ba'i tshigs bar ma bcag pa bdud rtsis 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyi bgegs bskrad lag pa g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ād+yan+na tād/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyi mnyam por thob par bsam/ lag g.yon sngar bzhin g.yas sdigs mdzub bsgreng pa rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ke te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis tshims par bsam/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa nang bcings byas pa'i mthe bong dpral bar bzhag pa dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥs man+ta budha naṃ gra he shwa re pra bhe ñja te ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par bsam/ de nas/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la ting nge 'dzin gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi༞ gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams༞ khyad par du khro bo'i rgyal po rme ba brtsegs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis༞ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi/ deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tsher bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren par thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas glud len par 'dir mchis te so so'i gzugs brnyan la thim par gyur cig

ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa la lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril rgya kyai rdor sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin tshar gsum/ rol mo hod kyis len pa sogs phur bzlog gtor ma'i dam yes gshegs pa'i bzlog pa 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i 'gor byed pa bzhin la dgu brdungs gnyis rnga phyir brdungs kyi/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro rgyal rme ba brtsegs/ /dregs 'joms rgyal po he ru ka /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad dang / /grib bdag thams cad dang ma nyon/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi ni/ /mun pa nag po'i gting rum na/ /grib 'khar nag po'i nang shed na/ /grib bdag nag po chen po khyod/ /sku mdog nag la mun pa'i mdog /chibs su grib rta nag po chibs/ /grib gos nag po rgyab la gyon/ /grib dar nag po lag na 'phyar/ /grib phru nag po mgo la btsugs/ /grib bya nag po klad la lding / /grib khyi nag po rgyab tu 'khrid/ /grib bdag chen pos grib longs shig /de yi bka' nyan las byed pa/ /'dod chags bya nag mgo bo can/ /zhe sdang sbrul nag mgo bo can/ /gti mug phag nag mgo bo can/ /ma rig sbrul nag mgo bo can/ /khyod ni grib kyi bdag po yin/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /zas grib gos grib nor gyis grib/ /de 'dra'i grib rnams bsangs gyur cig /mdzo grib btsog grib yug sa'i grib/ /de 'dra'i༞ /dmar grib dme grib gdon gyi grib/ /de 'dra'i༞ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin grib/ /de 'dra'i༞ /rgyal po 'byung po 'gong po'i grib/ /de 'dra'i༞ /the'u rang dri za gnod byed bgegs/ /de 'dra'i༞ /nyon mongs dug lnga las kyi grib/ /de 'dra'i༞ /sngar gyi khas blangs nyams chags grib/ /de 'dra'i༞ /grib bdag chen po grib gsol cig /grib bdag khyod la rdzongs btab bo/ /'bru srid 'bru nag tshig phye la/ /grib gtor nag po'i dam rdzas dang /

/ngar mi lan chags 'chang bu dang / /grib yon cha ma phyo dgu dang / /grib bdag khyod la rdzongs btab bo/ /grib bdag chen po grib gsol lo/ /nor grib de 'dra'i dang cha ma/ /phyo dgu'i mjug gi grib gsol cig /tshig rol la dgu brdung yang / hūm̐ nga ni khro rgyal nas/ cha ma phyo dgu'i mjug gi grib gsol bar tshar gsum byas la glud gtor rnams kha phyir bsgyur tsam lam gtang la/ mchog sbyin gyis phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ya a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ oṃ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe baṃ ho shud+dhe taṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ e baṃ raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe ma ya a swāhā/ zhes se gol gtogs pa lan nyer gcig sogs kyi bsngos/ thal mo sbyar te grib rdzas las grub pa'i gtor glud grib yon sna tshogs dang bcas pa grib bdag gang 'dod kyi yon tan dang ldan pa 'di gnod byed 'khor bcas tshim nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas grib kyi gnod pa las grol bar gyur cig kyai/ grib bdag khyod la lam bstan pa/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na/ /mun pa nag po'i klong dkyil na/ /grib yul mun pa nag re skyid/ /grib mkhar nag po rdzong re btsan/ /grib mkhar nag po'i gting rum du/ /grib bdag chen po der song zhig /'di na khyod kyi gnas ma mchis/ /grib nad gsol la der song zhig /grib bdag rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /tshig rol dgu rdung / kyai/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yis/ /mgo nad sprin ltar gtibs pa der/ /grib bdag rgyal po khyod la byol/ /lce nad rlung bzhin g.yo ba de/ /grib bdag༞ /snying nad me ltar 'bar ba de/ /grib bdag༞ /mchin nad nya ltar 'phar ba de/ /grib bdag༞ /nang cha bu dgu na ba de/ /grib bdag༞ /mkha' nad chu ltar 'khrug pa de/ /grib bdag༞ /sna nad zhang phul na ba de/ /grib bdag༞ /phung po lnga po na ba de/ /grib bdag༞

/ma mo phur bu na ba de/ /grib bdag༞ /mig dang so la na ba de/ /grib bdag༞ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /bcings pa yod na bkrol du gsol/ /mnan pa yod na bteg du gsol/ /sbyin bdag lus ngag yid gsum la/ /gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs/ /'dre gdon rigs gyur thams cad rnams/ /nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing / /glud bdag rnams kyi glud 'di khyer/ /tshig rol dgu rdung / hūm̐/ grib bdag shar gyi phyogs su song / /shar phyogs dri za'i phyogs su song / /dri za'i gdon rnams bsang gyur cig /grib bdag lho'i༞ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i yul du song / /gshin rje༞ /grib bdag nub kyi phyogs༞ /nub phyogs klu yi༞ /klu'i༞ /grib bdag byang༞ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin༞ /gnod sbyin༞ /phyogs bzhi dang ni mtshams brgyad dang / /steng 'og gdon rnams da song zhig /phyogs mtshams gang na gnas pa'i gdon/ /grib bdag chen po rang gnas song / /da lta nyid du mi 'gro na/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ngas/ /thal ba'i rdul du rlag par bgyis/ /sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing kun du rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o// //ces brjod cing rdor dril sogs dkrol drag dung drag brdung gu gum gyi dud pas bdug yungs dkar gyi brab te bgegs rnams rang gnas su song bar bsam la glud gtor 'dre lnga phyogs su bskyal/ mjug chog sbyangs 'khrus sogs bya'o/ /yang bkru byab bsrung gsum dang sbrel nas byed na ljang dud gang ltar na'ang gong gi snag dpon yi ge bzhin la der/ mi gsal rnams 'di nas kha bskang ste nyams su blang pa'i 'thus so zhes pa'ang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos 'phral du bris pa 'di'i rnga rol tshogs ni rang rang lag len gang byas chog go/
